The two-tier amendment is justified by this calibration-only evidence and by the bf16 8-bit mantissa, not by evaluation timing outcomes.

failure_facts.gate: frozen pilot tolerance atol=2^-8=0.00390625, rtol=0, zero isclose failures required
failure_facts.interpretation: placement-induced regrouping changes FP8 grouped-GEMM tile boundaries and DeepEP combine summation order; floating-point addition is non-associative, so isolated 1-ulp bf16 flips are inherent to permuting expert placement. A mapping error would corrupt every token of the affected experts with O(1) relative errors and would also fail identity; identity, m2 and random layouts all passed on the same capture and start.
